title: Syrian-Style Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and aromatic stew inspired by Syrian cuisine, made with tender lamb and exotic spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, ginger, and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cinnamon, allspice, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the apricots and 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Skim off any excess fat and serve hot, garnished with parsley.
Serve with couscous or rice, if desired.
